description: Main source file for Bluetooth Object Transfer Client sample using Zephyr RTOS, implementing BLE scanning, connection, GATT discovery, and OTS client operations.

methods.name: print_hex_number
methods.description: Prints a byte array as a hexadecimal number.

methods.name: otc_btn_work_fn
methods.description: Handles button work actions such as object selection, reading metadata, writing, and reading object data.

methods.name: otc_checksum_work_fn
methods.description: Schedules checksum calculation for the current object.

methods.name: button_pressed
methods.description: Callback for button press events, schedules work accordingly.

methods.name: configure_button_irq
methods.description: Configures GPIO interrupt for a button.

methods.name: configure_buttons
methods.description: Initializes button GPIOs and interrupts.

methods.name: eir_found
methods.description: Parses advertisement data to find OTS UUID and initiates connection.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Handles discovered BLE devices and filters for connectable OTS devices.

methods.name: start_scan
methods.description: Starts BLE scanning for OTS devices.

methods.name: subscribe_func
methods.description: Subscribes to OTS Object Control Point and List Control Point indications.

methods.name: is_discovery_complete
methods.description: Checks if all GATT discovery steps are completed.

methods.name: discover_func
methods.description: Handles GATT discovery process for OTS service characteristics.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon BLE connection establishment, initiates GATT discovery.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon BLE disconnection, restarts scanning.

methods.name: on_obj_selected
methods.description: Callback when an object is selected via OLCP.

methods.name: on_obj_metadata_read
methods.description: Callback when object metadata is read.

methods.name: on_obj_data_read
methods.description: Callback when object data is received.

methods.name: on_obj_data_written
methods.description: Callback after object data is written.

methods.name: on_obj_checksum_calculated
methods.description: Callback when checksum calculation completes, compares with last sent checksum.

methods.name: bt_otc_init
methods.description: Initializes the OTS client callbacks and registers the client.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, setting up OTS client, and starting scan.
